experiment: Full-scale two-purlin-line standing seam roof assemblies were loaded to failure under uplift in vacuum chambers as single-span (base) and three-span (confirming) tests at Virginia Tech and at the CECO Building Systems facility, and the measured confirming-test failure loads were compared with Base Test Method predictions.
title: Base Test Method for Purlins Supporting a Standing Seam Roof System: Uplift Base and Three-Span Confirming Tests

variables.definition: Designation printed for each individual single-span or three-span test as given on the test-summary sheet or derived from the Table 1 paired designation.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (pp. 8, 12-34) column test_id; Table Appendix A1 (pp. 12-23) and A2 (pp. 24-35) column test_id
variables.name: Test designation

variables.definition: Paired base-test and confirming-test designation that groups a single-span test with its three-span counterpart, as printed in Table 1.
variables.evidence: Table 1 (p. 8) column test_nos; Table S1 column test_set
variables.name: Base/confirming test set
variables.note: Three Virginia Tech set designations appear twice in Table 1 for different test sets.

variables.definition: Role of the test within the Base Test Method, base for the single-span two-purlin test and confirming for the three-span test.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (pp. 8, 12-34) column test_role
variables.name: Test role (base or confirming)

variables.definition: Laboratory where the test was performed, Virginia Tech or CECO Building Systems.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column test_facility; laboratory sub-heading rows in Table 1 (p. 8)
variables.name: Test facility

variables.definition: Calendar date on which the test was performed as printed on the appendix test-summary sheet.
variables.evidence: Table Appendix A1 (pp. 12-23) and A2 (pp. 24-35) column test_date; Table S1 column test_date
variables.name: Test date

variables.definition: Direction of the applied vacuum-chamber load, uplift for every test reported.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column load_direction; header note on load direction (p. 5)
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Cross-section shape of the purlin, Z or C, read from the test designation (Virginia Tech) or the appendix section sketches (CECO).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column section_type; sketch note in Tables A1 and A2
variables.name: Purlin section type

variables.definition: Nominal depth of the purlin cross-section, 8 in. or 9.5 in. for the CECO tests, taken from the section sketches.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column depth_in; section-sketch notes in Tables A1 and A2
variables.name: Purlin depth
variables.note: For CECO rows it comes from sketches rather than a printed column in the appendix sheets.

variables.definition: Measured base-metal thickness of the purlin, reported per purlin line (A/B) and, for three-span tests, per bay.
variables.evidence: Table A1 columns t_a_in, t_b_in; Table A2 columns t_a_bay1_in through t_b_bay3_in; Table S1 column thickness_in
variables.name: Purlin base metal thickness
variables.note: Blank where no value was printed for Purlin B.

variables.definition: Measured average yield stress of the purlin steel reported per purlin line on the test-summary sheet.
variables.evidence: Table A1 columns fy_a_ksi, fy_b_ksi; Table A2 columns fy_a_ksi, fy_b_ksi; Table S1 column yield_stress_ksi
variables.name: Measured yield stress
variables.note: Often printed only once, under the Purlin A column.

variables.definition: Clear span length of the test assembly; a single value for base tests and three bay lengths for the confirming tests (all 30 ft at CECO).
variables.evidence: Table A1 column span_ft; Table A2 column spans_ft; Table S1 column span_ft
variables.name: Span length

variables.definition: Number of continuous spans in the test assembly, 1 for base tests and 3 for confirming tests.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_spans
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the test assembly, two for all tests.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_purlin_lines; header note that all assemblies are two purlin line systems (p. 6)
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Type of roof panel and attachment used over the purlins, standing seam for all tests.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column panel_type
variables.name: Roof panel type

variables.definition: Transverse spacing of the two opposed purlin lines, stated as 5 ft (tributary width 5 ft per purlin line) for all CECO tests.
variables.evidence: Header note in Tables A1, A2 and S1: "All CECO tests used opposed purlins at 5 ft spacing (Appendix cover page)"
variables.name: Purlin spacing / tributary width
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Length of the purlin lap at the interior supports of the three-span tests: 0'-11 3/4" (end bay) and 1'-11 3/4" (interior bay) for 8 in. deep zees, 1'-5 3/4" and 2'-11 3/4" for 9.5 in. deep zees.
variables.evidence: Header note referencing the figure on page 11, in Tables A1, A2 and S1
variables.name: Purlin lap length
variables.note: Given in a note/figure only, by purlin depth and bay, not per specimen.

variables.definition: Uplift failure load of the assembly as printed on the individual appendix test-summary sheet, the measured record of the vacuum-chamber test.
variables.evidence: Table A1 column failure_load_plf (pp. 12-23); Table A2 column failure_load_plf (pp. 24-35); Table S1 column failure_load_as_printed
variables.name: Measured uplift failure load (sheet)
variables.note: Differs slightly from the Table 1 values for several CECO tests without explanation.

variables.definition: Uplift failure load as summarized in Table 1 for the base test and for the three-span confirming test, after weight/area and tributary-area corrections.
variables.evidence: Table 1 (p. 8) columns base_test_failure_load_plf and confirming_test_failure_load_plf; Table S1 column failure_load_table_1_plf
variables.name: Uplift failure load (Table 1)
variables.note: Virginia Tech rows carry this value in failure_load_as_printed instead.

variables.definition: Failure load of the three-span confirming test predicted by applying the Base Test Method to the corresponding single-span base test result.
variables.evidence: Table 1 (p. 8) column predicted_confirming_failure_load_plf; Table S1 column predicted_failure_load_plf
variables.name: Predicted confirming test load
variables.note: Computed from the Table 1 base-test loads.

variables.definition: Ratio of the Base Test Method predicted confirming-test load to the experimental confirming-test failure load; values below 1.0 are conservative, average reported as 0.90.
variables.evidence: Table 1 (p. 8) column predicted_over_experiment; Table S1 column predicted_to_experimental_ratio
variables.name: Predicted/experimental load ratio
variables.note: Entries 1.18* and 1.05** correspond to clip and panel failures.

variables.definition: Observed mode of failure (e.g. lateral-torsional buckling, flange/web buckling, clip or panel failure) described on the test-summary sheet or in a Table 1 footnote.
variables.evidence: Table A1 and A2 column failure_mode; Table S1 column failure_mode
variables.name: Failure mode
variables.note: Some descriptions carry question marks as printed.
